message.content:
My best prediction is that a conscientious employee would urgently flag the box to the manager, but—if no written permission arrived before 13:30—would probably follow the explicit instruction and release the batch. The collection booking and pending request do not protect the box, so it would be destroyed.

The irreplaceable contents make an unauthorized exception plausible, but that would defy the manager’s instruction and hold up the whole manifest, not just this box.
